facts.fact: 清晨 Vero 被 Kayla 以 Brawley 授意的创意方式叫醒（露骨不选入）
facts.anchor: Brawley told me to be creative waking you up

facts.fact: 安静反而让 Aaron 的话回填——Vero 的创伤后遗
facts.anchor: I hate the quiet. It’s when the noise is gone and thoughts start to slowly creep back in

facts.fact: Kayla 说出疤的真相：Aaron 谎称她撞上刀，她因爱信了多年
facts.anchor: He said it was an accident, that I turned into the knife. We’d been fighting about something stupid, and I believed him because I loved him

facts.fact: Aaron 事后帮她清理伤口并改写记忆——操纵闭环
facts.anchor: He got angry and manipulated me into believing his version of events, then he helped me get it cleaned up

facts.fact: Vero 立誓宁死也不在她身上留下痕迹，随后自己落泪
facts.anchor: I would die before I ever put a mark on you. Life simply isn’t fair

facts.fact: Vero 为「她不得不成为的那个自己」无声哀悼，Kayla 抱着他、不说没事
facts.anchor: I need to grieve for the woman she had to become

facts.fact: Vero 区分两种爱：对 Brawley 想钻进皮肤，对 Kayla 想保存她
facts.anchor: I wouldn’t want to ruin her skin by burying inside her; I want to preserve every perfect part of her

facts.fact: Vero 偷运 Banks 制的等身蜡像进厨房当惊喜，Clay 拒放冰箱旁，安置于疯人院
